// Grade-based directed modularity for Concept -> Concept edges
MATCH (a:Concept)-[r]->(b:Concept)
WITH collect({src: a.grade, dst: b.grade}) AS edges, count(r) AS m
UNWIND edges AS e
WITH edges, m, collect(DISTINCT e.src) + collect(DISTINCT e.dst) AS raw_comms
UNWIND raw_comms AS comm
WITH DISTINCT edges, m, comm
WITH m,
     size([e IN edges WHERE e.src = comm]) AS k_out,
     size([e IN edges WHERE e.dst = comm]) AS k_in,
     size([e IN edges WHERE e.src = comm AND e.dst = comm]) AS e_cc
WITH m, sum((1.0 * e_cc / m) - (1.0 * k_out * k_in / (m * m))) AS q
RETURN CASE WHEN m > 0 THEN q ELSE 0 END AS modularity
